name: IskraCore Flyer Manager
author: Amir Balic

sections.description:
IskraCore Flyer Manager lets editors upload flyers and catalogs, assign retailers and categories, and publish currently valid offers using the [flyerhub] shortcode.

Free includes individual flyer management, retailer profiles, validity dates, optional public filters, PDF/image previews and a basic overview. Advanced bulk tools, QR image generation and the Analytics dashboard are separate premium features, not included in this free plugin. Free does not require a premium license to function.

The plugin stores aggregate event counts to support compatibility with an optional separate add-on. It does not store IP addresses or user agents permanently in the analytics table.

Upgrading from Amda Flyers or Digital Flyer & Catalog Manager

Deactivate the previous plugin before activating this renamed package. Do not run both simultaneously. Do not delete the old plugin or its database content until the upgrade has been tested and backed up.

A one-time administrator-only migration renames the legacy flyer post type and taxonomies, and copies existing metadata and display settings to namespaced keys. The original metadata and settings remain in the database as recovery copies. Existing flyer IDs, term relationships and the [flyerhub] shortcode are preserved. Historical analytics counters are copied to the new table when available. Previously printed QR links with the legacy fh_qr parameter remain recognized.

Source code and build instructions

All JavaScript and CSS files in this plugin are the original, human-readable sources served directly by WordPress. No generated, compiled or minified frontend bundle is shipped, and no build tools are required.

In particular, iskracore-flyer-public.js and iskracore-flyer-retailer.js are the complete editable source files. The other original source files are iskracore-flyer-admin.js, iskracore-flyer.css and assets/admin-brand.css. See docs/SOURCE-CODE.md for details.

To make changes, edit those files directly and reload WordPress. No npm, webpack, build command or external source repository is needed.
sections.installation:
1. Back up your WordPress database and files before upgrading. Test updates on staging.
  2. Open Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin, choose the ZIP and activate IskraCore Flyer Manager.
  3. Create a page with [flyerhub].
  4. Add retailers, categories and flyers, attach PDF/image files, set dates and publish.
  5. Open the public page and verify the previews, filters and links.
sections.faq:
Does the plugin automatically download flyers from retailers?

No. Editors upload and manage files manually.

What happens to expired flyers?

They remain in WordPress but are hidden from the current public offers list.

Is Pro required?

No. All Free features work without Pro. QR image generation, bulk operations and an Analytics dashboard are separate add-on functionality.

Is the public shortcode changing?

No. Existing [flyerhub] shortcodes remain valid.
sections.changelog:
1.0.8

  • Escape WordPress-generated image, retailer logo and pagination HTML in the public shortcode.
  • Use context-appropriate escaping for public HTML attributes and contact links.
  • No database or public shortcode changes.

1.0.7

  • Sanitize and unslash public QR query parameters at the point of input.
  • Preserve existing QR destinations, legacy links and the public shortcode.
  • Keep the stylesheet human-readable and remove outdated branding in comments.

1.0.6

  • Clarify one-time database migration exceptions for WordPress coding standards.
  • Validate public QR query values before use and preserve legacy QR links.
  • Document why public read-only URL filters do not use expiring nonces.

1.0.5

  • Introduce the distinctive IskraCore Flyer Manager name and matching text domain.
  • Use unique IskraCore-prefixed post types, taxonomies, options and event identifiers.
  • Add a one-time legacy data migration that preserves original records and metadata.
  • Ship directly readable JavaScript sources and document the absence of a build step.
  • Preserve the [flyerhub] shortcode and legacy QR link support.

1.0.4

  • Separate Free flyer management from the optional Pro add-on.
